description: This Java source file defines the PermissionRequestFragment class, which manages a WebView to load a web app, handles runtime and permission requests, especially for camera access, and implements a WebChromeClient with custom permission and console message handling.

classes.name: PermissionRequestFragment
classes.description: A Fragment that hosts a WebView, manages permission requests for camera access, and handles web permissions via a custom WebChromeClient.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes the WebView, sets web chrome client, and configures WebView settings.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Starts the local web server and loads the web app if permissions are granted.

methods.name: onRequestPermissionsResult
methods.description: Handles results from runtime permission requests, specifically camera permission.

methods.name: requestCameraPermission
methods.description: Requests camera permission, showing rationale if needed.

methods.name: onOkClicked
methods.description: Triggers permission request for camera when user agrees.

methods.name: onConfirmation
methods.description: Grants or denies camera permission based on user confirmation.

methods.name: setConsoleMonitor
methods.description: Sets a monitor for console messages.
